# Vendored player-build dependencies

[Tomli](https://github.com/hukkin/tomli) 2.2.1 supplies TOML parsing on the Command Line Tools' Python 3.9; Python 3.11 and newer use the standard library's `tomllib`. Approved for phase 7 on 2026-11-02. The unmodified Python sources come from the [PyPI wheel](https://pypi.org/project/tomli/2.2.1/), `tomli-2.2.1-py3-none-any.whl`, SHA-256 `cb55c73c5f4408779d0cf3eef9f762b9c9f147a77de7b258bef0a5628adc85cc`. Its [MIT license](tomli/LICENSE) stays beside the code. No pip installation is needed on a player's Mac.
